Story told only through a northern ice palace plaza, ice lanterns and a small colorful paper parasol.
Panel 1: dawn plaza with exactly SIX distinct snowflake-shaped ice lanterns in a clear countable arc; the smallest one has a few melt droplets.
Panel 2: warm sunlight reaches the smallest lantern; a folded colorful paper parasol lies beside it as the clear solution, while faint harmless icy sparkle recedes.
Panel 3: smallest lantern safely moved under a leafy tree and covered by the open paper parasol; melting has stopped.
Panel 4: cloudy sunset close view of the smallest lantern with one repaired crack glowing gently.
Panel 5: nighttime wide plaza showing exactly SIX distinct glowing snowflake ice lanterns, all separately visible and countable, reflected on the ice; no other lanterns anywhere.
Panel 6: quiet close view of smallest intact lantern with its paper parasol left beside it, symbolizing patience and care.

corrections.reason: initial environment atlas had five rather than six lanterns in panels 1 and 5
corrections.prompt:

Asset type: corrected six-scene story atlas

In the top-left panel, add exactly one matching lantern so exactly SIX distinct, separate, fully visible lanterns can be counted.
In the bottom-left nighttime panel, add exactly one matching lantern so exactly SIX distinct, separate, fully visible lanterns can be counted.
Place the added lanterns naturally in the existing spacing and perspective. Keep the smallest lantern distinct. Do not add lanterns in the other four panels.
Constraints: top-left exactly six; bottom-left exactly six; no text, numbers, labels, border, watermark, new characters or layout changes. Preserve 2x3 grid and original quality.
